risks: We may not receive the expected $600 million in equity and establish a $250 million revolving credit facility by 2027.
The Stillwater Facility is under development and we lack commercial operations, limiting the accuracy of any forward-looking forecasts.
We may not be able to secure the necessary feedstock or equipment to economically produce neo magnets.
The Round Top Project might not be commercially viable and could face numerous risks.
Changes in U.S. and China relations could adversely affect our financial condition and results of operations.

growth_drivers: USA Rare Earth Inc. acquired a 13.6% equity interest in Carester SAS for $45.7 million.
USA Rare Earth received a grant of up to $14.2 million from the Texas Semiconductor Innovation Fund for the Round Top Project.
USA Rare Earth announced the first commercial production of yttrium metal, positioning itself among a limited number of such producers outside China.
USA Rare Earth Inc. plans to expand its rare earth magnet manufacturing capacity to meet anticipated growth in demand across various sectors.
risks: Gross margin declined to a negative 27.2% in Q2'2026 due to increased raw material costs.
USA Rare Earth must establish a $250.0 million revolving credit facility by June 30, 2027.
The Serra Verde acquisition will require $300.0 million in cash consideration.

growth_drivers: The Stillwater Facility would position us as one of the few domestic producers of sintered NdFeB permanent magnet.
USA Rare Earth Inc. is evaluating opportunities to expand its rare earth magnet manufacturing capacity to support anticipated growth in demand across key sectors.
The Expected U.S. Government Transaction is expected to support a business that by 2030 should extract up to 40,000 metric tons per day of rare earth and critical mineral feedstock from the Round Top
USA Rare Earth aims to develop the Round Top Deposit into a producing mine, reducing dependence on foreign supply chains.
risks: The U.S. Government Transaction could provide $1.6 billion but is subject to milestones and there is no assurance of funding.
The Stillwater Facility requires substantial capital and may face delays or cost overruns.
USA Rare Earth needs to raise at least $600 million by December 31, 2027.
The accounting for business combinations requires significant judgments and is considered a critical accounting estimate.
The valuation of certain warrant and earnout share liabilities is subject to variability due to unobservable inputs and assumptions.

growth_drivers: Engaged over 30 potential customers, including large multinationals.
Received production purchase orders from customers in the industrial motion control sector and aerospace and defense sector.
Building a multiyear relationship with a customer turns the purchase order into a durable form of customer intimacy.
Acquiring Serra Verde for light and heavy rare earths and investing in Carester for processing capability.
Building the global leader in rare earths, essential for modern economy sectors.
risks: Active engagement with alternative supply sources and expectations of positive momentum in pricing.

growth_drivers: The company expects to expand demand beyond 2,500 tons annually with new customers.
USA Rare Earth Inc. is creating a global supply chain outside of China, focusing on heavy rare earths.
USA Rare Earth has 12 MOUs and is ramping up Stillwater's capacity to 1,200 metric tons by early next year.
Swarf from magnet production could represent 20% to 30% of raw material oxides.
